title: Thank You
heading: Thank you for your generosity
lede: Your contribution helps Hijaz Hospital Trust provide quality healthcare to deserving patients and strengthens our mission of serving humanity with compassion and dignity.
quote: "Whoever saves one life, it is as if he has saved all mankind." (Qur'an 5:32)
body: Every act of giving helps save lives. Whether you chose Zakat, Sadaqah, a general donation, or another way to give, your support enables free and subsidized care for patients who cannot afford treatment.
Official donation receipts are issued for all contributions. Please share your payment details with our Donations Office to receive your acknowledgement and receipt.

nextSteps.title: Need a receipt?
nextSteps.body: Contact the Donations Office with your payment reference so we can issue your official acknowledgement.

nextSteps.title: Continue supporting
nextSteps.body: Explore other ways to give — sponsor a patient, donate a meal, or support hospital projects.
